clauses.title: Manufacture and chemical and physical
clauses.text: 1.1 Manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of rapid hardening Portland cement. Note —The term 'rapid  hardening' should not be  confused with 'quick- setting.'

clauses.title: Chemical Requirment
clauses.text: 2. Chemical Requirment — Shall be as laid down in IS  269:1989*.

clauses.title: Fineness
clauses.text: 3.1 Fineness — Specific surface shall not be less than 325 m2/kg.

clauses.title: Soundness
clauses.text: 3.2 Soundness — Unaerated Cement SUMMARY OF IS  8041 : 1990  RAPID HARDENING PORTLAND CEMENT (Second Revision) Not more than 10 mm ('Le Chatelier' method). Not more than 0.8 percent (autoclave).

clauses.title: Setting Time
clauses.text: 3.3 Setting Time: Initial setting 30 minutes, final setting 10 h.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength of Mortar Cubes
clauses.text: 3.4 Compressive Strength of Mortar Cubes a) 24 hours 30 Not less than 16 MPa minutes b) 72 1 hours Not less than 27 MPa

clauses.title: Delivery
clauses.text: 4 Delivery — Packed in specified bags of 50 kg or 25 kg net or in bulk with tolerances specified in the standard. Note —  For methods of tests, refer to relevant parts of  IS 4031 Methods of physical tests for  hydraulic cement, and IS 4032:1985 Method of chemical analysis of hydraulic cement.( first revision) *Ordinary Portland cement,33 Grade. For detailed information, refer to IS  8041: 1990 Specification for rapid hardening portland cement (second revision). ± ±
